purpose: Explain patterns across nine student projects

required_facts.fact: bAIpacking retrieves race evidence for cyclist equipment.
Meal-Map has cost and call limits with deterministic fallback.
Decision Memory returns structured decision cards.
Cyber Sachet answers in English and Nepali with citations.
SnapSplit reruns OCR and escalates mismatches.
AMR combines BM25 and BioBERT retrieval.
Regulation research uses local retrieval and web/legal services.

author_attribution: Explain the students' systems without claiming uniform outcomes.
